survey_design.weight_fields_interpretation: This OECD country note summarizes system-level indicators for the United States using published Education at a Glance 2025 data. It does not provide an analysis section with an analytic micro-dataset, sampling frame, or student-level estimation procedure that would allow identification of complex survey weights or replicate-weight methods. The note reports cross-country comparisons (e.g., PIAAC literacy levels, expenditure per student, unemployment by educational attainment) using OECD indicator calculations rather than a student-level modeling workflow. Therefore, no specific weight variable (e.g., W_FSTUWT) or replicate scheme (e.g., BRR/jackknife) is documented for re-analysis here; users should consult the referenced Education at a Glance 2025 Sources, Methodologies and Technical Notes for indicator-specific sampling and weighting details.

data.outcome_summary: This OECD Education at a Glance 2025 country note provides a descriptive overview of the United States’ education system characteristics using the latest available OECD indicator data. It emphasizes tertiary education and reports system-level measures such as education expenditure per student and as a share of GDP, tuition fees and student aid coverage, and financial returns to tertiary education. For adult skills, it summarizes PIAAC literacy proficiency distributions (e.g., the share at Level 1 or below) and trends across PIAAC cycles (2012–2023). It also reports labour-market associations with educational attainment (unemployment rates by attainment, wage gaps) and education participation/progression indicators (pre-primary enrolment, private-school shares, tertiary entry fields). No student-level large-scale assessment microdata modeling, plausible-value estimation, or ML prediction is conducted in this note; it is intended for policy context rather than causal or predictive inference.
data.null_fields_interpretation: This is not an empirical ML paper and does not present an original student-level analysis with a defined analytic sample, model training, or reported predictive performance metrics. As a result, fields such as total_students, per-country sample sizes, plausible-value handling, missing-data handling, and ML techniques are not meaningfully defined for the note’s content. The note instead compiles and summarizes OECD indicator outputs, so the appropriate methodological details are located in the referenced Education at a Glance 2025 methodology/technical notes rather than in an analysis section within this document.
